items.t: Why Are Freeport McMoRan (FCX) Shares Jumping On AI Driven Copper Demand?
items.sum: Freeport-McMoRan (NYSE: FCX) climbed as copper miners rallied after Nvidia's CEO was reinstated, with some market participants linking AI sentiment to metal demand. Copper prices moved sharply higher following the leadership resolution at Nvidia, and traders cited AI infrastructure optimism as a factor related to potential future copper use. Market commentary connected renewed interest in AI data
